title: Bow Pear Drop Necklace
descriptionHtml:
A bow of two hearts, and a drop below. Two heart shaped clear cubic zirconia meet point to point at a small polished gold knot to form the loops of a bow, and from the knot a single clear pear cut stone hangs on a tiny jump ring. The bow is about 10mm wide and the whole pendant about 15mm tall, on a fine gold tone cable chain.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone at the base of the throat, with a shirt open at the collar.

Details

  • Pendant: A bow of two heart cut stones with a pear drop, approximately 15mm tall
  • Bow: Approximately 10mm wide
  • Stone: Clear cubic zirconia, two hearts and one pear of approximately 6mm
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Chain: Fine cable chain
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
